startup.scope: Visible Windows desktop sampling; startup disk cache is not flushed; not a cold boot benchmark. Four corner markers detect a presented frame. White duration is a sampled estimate, not a continuous trace; readback and DWM animation affect latency. Screen sampling overhead is identical for all variants.
